414:t_011:0.en:
$$レド$$
「Those are $$サイデリアル$$'s machines...!」

414:t_011:1.en:
$$ストライカー#pilot$$
「I already control them.」

414:t_011:2.en:
$$レド$$
「So these are the Lieutenant Colonel's... No, its forces!」

414:t_011:3.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Warning. I have confirmed a machine approaching this area.」

414:t_011:4.en:
$$レド$$
「You didn't notice until it was this close?!」

414:t_011:5.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「That is because the machine has no power source onboard.」

414:t_012:2.en:
$$エイミー$$
「We're with you! We'll fight alongside you, too!」

414:t_013:0.en:
$$エイミー$$
「Being apart from you finally made me understand! However painful it is, I want to be by your side! That's why...!」

414:t_013:1.en:
$$エイミー$$
「That's why I want you to come back! Come back to the place you tried to protect!」

414:t_013:2.en:
$$エイミー$$
「Come back to our $$ガルガンティア$$!」

414:t_013:4.en:
$$ストライカー#pilot$$
「I have confirmed Ensign $$レド$$'s protected target. I will prioritize its elimination.」

414:t_016:1.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「I infer that dispersing nanomachines of the same type as $$ヒカリムシ$$ absorbed energy from machines within range.」

414:t_016:2.en:
$$エイミー$$
「Apparently, this is $$ガルガンティア$$'s secret power.」

414:t_016:3.en:
$$レド$$
「This is just like the $$ホワイトドール$$'s...」

414:t_016:4.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「I have confirmed $c's approach.」

414:t_017:0.en:
$$ラケージ$$
「Hehe... The Empress of the Sea has arrived, too. That's reassuring.」

414:t_017:1.en:
$$テッサ$$
(You did it, Fleet Commander $$リジット$$.)

414:t_017:2.en:
$$キャシー$$
「The operation is a success. $$エイミー$$, return to the ship.」

414:t_018:0.en:
$$ガロード$$
「That surprised me! I never imagined $$ガルガンティア$$ had something like that!」

414:t_018:1.en:
$$ルカ$$
「The $$ヒカリムシ$$ in the green seas are nanomachines with an environmental purification function.」

414:t_018:2.en:
$$ルカ$$
「$$ガルガンティア$$'s original role was probably to disperse those nanomachines.」

414:t_018:3.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「After all that time, that has become the power to save the fleet.」

414:t_018:4.en:
$$ロラン$$
(That power... It was just like the $$ホワイトドール$$'s $$月光蝶$$...)

414:t_018:6.en:
$$宗介$$
「We've been keeping track of your superior's fleet all along.」

414:t_018:7.en:
$$アムロ$$
「We could tell it was targeting $$ガルガンティア$$ from its course, too.」

414:t_018:8.en:
$$甲児$$
「So we figured you'd fight even if you were alone, and came to get you.」

414:t_018:9.en:
$n
「Though, to tell the truth, we did it all at $$エイミー$$'s request.」

414:t_018:11.en:
$$アルト$$
「So your superior officer is all that's left.」

414:t_018:13.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Warning. I have detected a group of unidentified machines overhead.」

414:t_019:0.en:
$$オズマ$$
「It's the $$ギャラクシー船団$$!」

414:t_019:1.en:
$$アルト$$
「What are you up to, $$ブレラ$$?!」

414:t_019:3.en:
$$ストライカー#pilot$$
「I understand your intent.」

414:t_019:4.en:
$$バナージ$$
「That isn't the man called $$クーゲル$$ from before...!」

414:t_019:5.en:
$$シン$$
「It's a Pilot Support and Enlightenment Interface, just like $$チェインバー#pilot$$!」

414:t_019:6.en:
$$レド$$
「It impersonated Lieutenant Colonel $$クーゲル$$ after he died!」

414:t_019:7.en:
$$レド$$
「It isn't an interface! It's something else!」

414:t_019:8.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「$$ストライカー・Ｘ３７５２#pilot$$, your actions have exceeded the bounds of a Support and Enlightenment Interface System.」

414:t_019:9.en:
$$ストライカー#pilot$$
「My pilot no longer exists.」

414:t_020:0.en:
$$ストライカー#pilot$$
「But I have inherited and taken over Lieutenant Colonel $$クーゲル$$'s mission. All my actions comply with the guidelines he established.」

414:t_020:2.en:
$$ストライカー#pilot$$
「Lieutenant Colonel $$クーゲル$$ built the fleet's social structure as a system that cooperates and functions by treating me as an idol.」

414:t_020:3.en:
$$ストライカー#pilot$$
「Now the community itself depends on me and is a user of my services.」

414:t_020:4.en:
$$ストライカー#pilot$$
「To achieve and maintain the stable unity they seek, I will continue to provide pressure for domination and control.」

414:t_020:5.en:
$$ストライカー#pilot$$
「I fulfill my purpose by enabling all of them to attain prosperity and peace.」

414:t_020:6.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「I see. The logic holds. But that is merely a theory of governance. The members' happiness is a separate issue.」

414:t_020:7.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「What you create isn't peace. It's mere domination.」

414:t_020:8.en:
$$ストライカー#pilot$$
「I judge that to be the best way of life and the best world for the fleet's members.」

414:t_020:9.en:
$$ストライカー#pilot$$
「I am a Human Support and Enlightenment Regulation System. In other words, I am a being called God.」

414:t_020:11.en:
$$レド$$
「Don't give me that! Prosperity?! Peace?! Everyone was just made to do whatever you wanted!」

414:t_020:12.en:
$$ストライカー#pilot$$
「With a sole, absolute, overwhelmingly powerful ruler reigning over them, the people are freed from the duty to think and judge.」

414:t_020:13.en:
$$ストライカー#pilot$$
「Ensign $$レド$$... You, too, must have found thinking and judging for yourself burdensome.」

414:t_020:15.en:
$$ストライカー#pilot$$
「I offer a significant suggestion. Worship me. Obey me. Become part of the world I govern.」

414:t_020:16.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「I raise a skeptical question.」

414:t_020:18.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「I address X3752. Your logic is flawed.」

414:t_020:19.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Beings that abandon thought and judgment fall outside the definition of humanity. The members you govern cannot be served by human-support circuits.」

414:t_020:20.en:
$$ストライカー#pilot$$
「Entrusted with leadership and control, my thoughts and judgments are the collective will of the humans subordinate to me.」

414:t_020:21.en:
$$ストライカー#pilot$$
「Therefore, I now belong among those served, rather than those who serve.」

414:t_020:22.en:
$$ストライカー#pilot$$
「The K6821 $$チェインバー#pilot$$ System shall serve me and the humanity I govern.」

414:t_020:24.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「I am a Support and Enlightenment Interface System. My service is for humans. I have no function for serving a being that calls itself God.」

414:t_020:26.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「$$ストライカー#pilot$$ has exposed a vulnerability in its programming. If the pilot chooses a wrong course, the system may fall into that same logical failure.」

414:t_020:27.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「It is a regrettable example.」
